classification.theory_summary: Author describes a practice of conversing with Mall World dream characters to increase lucidity and reports that characters feel familiar/recognize the dreamer; asks others about interactions and whether characters share unknown information.
classification.question_topic: How Mall World dream characters behave in interactions (familiarity/recognition; whether they provide information the dreamer didn't know).

meta.author_theory: Author reports that Mall World dream characters feel familiar and recognize the dreamer when spoken to; author uses conversation to become more lucid; author sometimes feels like a different version of self in Mall World.

interactions.description: Actively tries to converse with Mall World dream characters to force going more lucid; reports that when talking to them they recognize the dreamer and do not feel like strangers ("that feeling of 'where do I know this person from'").

entities_involved.description: Mall World dream characters who, when spoken to, recognize the dreamer; feel like familiar people whose appearance has changed ("Kinda like a grown up version of a middle school friend").

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains generalized recurring-dream observations and interaction phenomenology (conversation/recognition/lucidity attempt) but no specific Mall World locations, layout, routes, or boundaries.
